method: 83 frames: the 81 cull survivors in selects/Kutna Hora plus 7034 and 7002, posted but lost to twins in the cull. 600px sheets for all; 57 at 1000px; 100% crops on 28 subjects, sky dust checked on three. Instagram: one post matched by dHash in the browser, two by eye.

frames.critique: St Wenceslas house, lamp in silhouette: the lamp works; but a black building edge cuts in top left and a traffic mirror on a pole sits bottom centre. Half sky.
(sheet only) cars/umbrellas, postcard
lane, warm walls, cobbles lead to the pink house and one walker. Quiet, well built; nothing remarkable. Mihail at review: too much dead space without a tighter crop; out.
(sheet only) market stalls, beaten by 6977
horizontal vineyard view: vines fill the bottom third, blank white sky; left house cut. 7045 is cleaner.
IG cover. Statue line leads to St Barbara, the college on the right, blue sky. Red scaffolding at the cathedral's base is a blemish. Best establishing frame.
(sheet only) the chevet from the gate with a tour group; 6977 and 7025 say it better
(sheet only) empty paving
buttresses in warm light, tree lower left. Same framing as 6985.
B&W of the same view; darker sky makes the spires bite. Takes the pair (edit-twins).
sunstar over the apse, buttresses as ribs. Flare haze lowers contrast and a green ghost sits on the balustrade; tree left. On the site.
west front, horizontal, centred; tourists across the bottom edge, flat light on the shaded front. Prior. A record.
vertical over the flowerbed; a pram bottom left, tree at right edge. Loses to 7034.
west front through trees, lamp; tower of the college left; white sky. Toss-up with 7036.
pinnacles marching diagonally into a soft blue sky, warm stone. Graphic; the strongest exterior detail. Prior.
St James framed by trees and a lamp, from the cathedral terrace. Bottom third is lawn; grey sky. Mihail at review: slightly better than 7045 with the same subject; takes its place.

frames.focus: sharp, heavy noise in the vault
frames.critique: the apse straight up: heraldic star vault, glass, the tabernacle's tips at the bottom. Rich and ordered. Clear panes near white, fine.
posted twin of 7018; loses on the lamp and the cut vault.
posted. The pictorial window glowing in a dark wall, altar silhouette right. Handsome, but every visitor takes this.
posted. The window throws its colour onto the painted wall at right: a moment of light, not just a window. Takes the pair over 7004.
(sheet only) the tabernacle; 7016 has it with the miner
the miner statue alone, the fresco behind. Good character; parked behind 7016.

frames.focus: acceptable: the altar is dark and noisy
frames.critique: the nave to the altar, tabernacle at left, star vault above. Hanging lamps at right a small blemish. Prior.
from the gallery: buttress edge against the green valley. Nice contrast of stone and woods; white sky is half the right side.
posted. Side chapel: medieval angels on the wall, coloured glass at left, pews leading in. Warm, quiet, layered.
posted (rotated to vertical). The star vault flat-on, heraldry in the cells. Pure pattern; two tie-rods cross it, a small blemish. Post it the same way up as on Instagram.

frames.focus: sharp on the miner; the man with the phone slightly soft
frames.critique: the miner, the choir stalls and the tabernacle in one view, a stranger photographing from the pew. Tells the place and its visitors.
posted. The apse vault on a diagonal, red lamp hanging in at the left. More drama than 7000; same subject. Pick 7017, 7000 a strong park/toss-up.
the organ under the west window, tabernacle at right, vault above. Wins the pair: 7002 (posted) is tighter, darker and adds a hanging lamp.
a vaulted room, one window, light pooling on the paving. Mood and geometry. Little floor lights a small blemish.
side view in colour: grey sky, a woman with a baby cut by the right edge.
B&W of the side view; the couple with a pram adds scale; sky goes blank white. Takes the pair.
(sheet only) side view over bush, busier, beaten by 7025/7026
posted. Pinnacles marching away; the low wall and brick steps fill the bottom quarter, white sky top left. 6995 says the pinnacles better; this one says "walking round it".
(sheet only) Jesuit college, tourists, flat

frames.focus: sharp (window tracery; in-camera noise reduction smears the glass a little)
frames.critique: posted. Same view, flowerbed whole and centred, edges clean. The best frontal; still the classic view in shade. Establishing, strong 3.
tighter, bluer sky, lamp centred; the tree on the right is heavy. Takes the toss-up by a hair (sky); 6994 parked.
(sheet only) apse from below, beaten by 7031
(sheet only) a third side view, walkers
the statue balustrade with St James beyond; grey sky, muted. Ties to 6977's terrace.
vertical: wall and path give depth, but 45% grey sky. Prior. Wins over 6976.
(sheet only) St James tower over a yellow house, people and a dog
(sheet only) lane to the Jesuit tower, cars and an A-board
pink and yellow lane down to the old town, tourists from behind, a man at a café table. Busy, but it's the town alive; flat white sky. Strangers, all small.
the Stone Fountain's tracery; a blue van and a car at right, a yellow road line along the bottom. Blemishes, not fatal. Mihail at review: a documentary shot of the fountain, not a 3.
(sheet only) fountain detail, van again; 7054 says it
(sheet only) Šultysova downhill, cyclist, parked cars
(sheet only) street of houses, flat, cars
the Stone House, looking up: converging verticals, grey sky top left, a "Kingdom Come" banner at the bottom. Prior. A record of a fine facade.
(sheet only) Palackého square and the plague column, cars
the red alley: lamp, arch, a second arch beyond, strong colour and a clean line. A police car and restaurant signs at the end, small. Prior.
(sheet only) St James's organ; 7072 is the stronger interior
St James inside: symmetric nave to the Baroque altar, warm. Well made; one interior too many next to St Barbara's.
St Barbara and the college over the vineyard: the classic view. A dark house cuts in at right; half sky.
posted. St Barbara and the college through the gate's railings; frame within a frame, cobbles below, a lot of sky. Wins the trio for the frame; 7094 is the open view.
the painted house on Palackého: kings and saints under a blue sky, lamp at right. Colour and character. Prior.
the Italian Court garden: round flowerbed, fountain, statue, café umbrellas. Blue sky; a postcard. Prior.
(sheet only) courtyard oriel, barrier/bin clutter; 7085 says it
the oriel and the stair in the courtyard: warm walls, strong shapes, a bench and planter. Prior.
(sheet only) a plain courtyard corner
(sheet only) park lawn star bed, leaf intrudes top right, plain
the red bench with green ironwork under pink hydrangeas against the stone wall. A quiet favourite: colour and calm. Drain cover bottom left a blemish.
the open valley view from the Italian Court: St Barbara and the college over the park, blue sky; people tiny in the park. Better light than 7074. Prior.
(sheet only) vertical of 7094, the beech fills the bottom
hydrangeas along the wall, horizontal. Pretty and plain; 7090 says it with the bench. Prior.
(sheet only) the courtyard arcade, wide and level; 7104 and 7085 say the courtyard better
heraldic window, red crest among roundels. Bolder than 7102. Mihail at review: too crooked, and the concept sits apart from the rest of the set.
the crescent crest; darker. Prior. A pair with 7101; one is enough. Out with 7101: the window concept sits apart from the set.
(sheet only) courtyard from window, plain
the courtyard arcade, a dark blurred window edge down the left: reads as peeking, but stacked green chairs sit in the courtyard. Not worth its place over 7085.
St James's tower against cirrus; clean, a road-sign tip in the bottom right corner.
(sheet only) neo-Baroque yellow facade, a car roof along the bottom

frames.focus: not checked at 100% (1000px only, after review)
frames.critique: Sedlec from the side: the red roofs and the run of windows make a strong diagonal; white sky, but less of it than 7112. The better exterior (Mihail, confirmed at 1000px after review); parked, as Sedlec stays interior-only.
Sedlec's west front from below, symmetric, under a white-grey sky. The establishing frame for Sedlec, nothing more. Mihail at review: not an opener; Sedlec stays interior-only.
Sedlec nave from the choir: depth, red carpet, a black pulpit filling the left; the west window burns out.
from the gallery: arch inside arch down the aisle, one woman alone in the pews. The yellow is Sedlec. Railing edge bottom left, red rope bottom right.
the B&W of 7118: more graphic, loses the yellow that is the building's signature. A real toss-up; I lean colour.
(sheet only) Sedlec's organ wall

frames.focus: acceptable: the altar is dark and noisy
frames.critique: the nave from the gallery down to the altar: the ribbed vault and the long yellow walls, pews below.
(sheet only) twin of 7126 without the window
the spiral stair from above: wood, cream, iron. The foreground rail is soft (soft-intended). Prior.
the fresco in its ribbed frame, flat-on. Good, but 7126 and 7122 do the vaults better. Prior.
straight up the nave to the west window: Santini's ribs as a net, two tiny figures on the gallery. Prior.
